messages.subject: Project Indigo - SPA, sorry, sale contract v2 (redline)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Our mark-up of the sale contract is attached (redline against your v1). Key changes: price to £14,250,000 and deposit to £1,425,000; completion date 12 February 2026; and clause 7.2 tightened so the Seller needs our prior written approval before settling the Unit 3 review or accepting any surrender pending completion. Everything else is largely agreed.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
